stages.name: a
stages.query: SELECT __path,ast_kind AS kind,ast_name AS name,NULL AS alias,NULL AS module,NULL AS value,NULL AS value_kind,CAST(NULLIF(ast_preorder,'') AS INTEGER) AS id,CAST(NULLIF(NULL,'') AS INTEGER) AS bfs,CAST(NULLIF(ast_parent,'') AS INTEGER) AS parent,ast_field AS field,CAST(NULLIF(NULL,'') AS INTEGER) AS position,CAST(NULLIF(NULL,'') AS INTEGER) AS last,CAST(NULLIF(ast_function,'') AS INTEGER) AS fn,NULL AS op,CAST(NULLIF(ast_start,'') AS INTEGER) AS __start,CAST(NULLIF(ast_stop,'') AS INTEGER) AS __end,CAST(NULLIF(ast_line,'') AS INTEGER) AS line,NULL AS context,NULL AS name_repr,NULL AS value_repr,NULL AS annotation,NULL AS annotation_repr FROM canonical

stages.name: calls
stages.query:
SELECT c.*,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.name AS callee,f.id AS callee_id,r.id AS receiver,r.kind AS receiver_kind,r.name AS receiver_name
      FROM a c JOIN a f ON f.__path=c.__path AND f.parent=c.id AND f.field='func'
      LEFT JOIN a r ON r.__path=f.__path AND r.parent=f.id AND r.field='value'
      WHERE c.kind='Call'

stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT * FROM a WHERE kind IN ('FunctionDef','AsyncFunctionDef')

stages.name: calls
stages.query:
SELECT c.*,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.name AS callee,f.id AS callee_id,r.id AS receiver,r.kind AS receiver_kind,r.name AS receiver_name
      FROM a c JOIN a f ON f.__path=c.__path AND f.parent=c.id AND f.field='func'

stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT * FROM a WHERE kind IN ('FunctionDef','AsyncFunctionDef')

stages.name: parameters
stages.query: SELECT p.* FROM a p JOIN a arguments ON arguments.__path=p.__path AND arguments.id=p.parent AND arguments.kind='arguments' JOIN functions f ON f.__path=arguments.__path AND f.id=arguments.parent WHERE p.kind='arg'

stages.name: expression_roots
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE roots(__path,id,root,name) AS (
 SELECT __path,id,id,name FROM a WHERE kind='Name'
 UNION ALL SELECT parent.__path,parent.id,roots.root,roots.name FROM roots JOIN a parent ON parent.__path=roots.__path JOIN a child ON child.__path=roots.__path AND child.id=roots.id WHERE parent.id=child.parent AND parent.kind='Attribute' AND child.field='value') SELECT * FROM roots

stages.name: schema_parameters
stages.query: SELECT DISTINCT p.__path,p.fn,p.name FROM parameters p JOIN a annotation ON annotation.__path=p.__path AND annotation.parent=p.id AND annotation.field='annotation' JOIN a term ON term.__path=annotation.__path AND term.id BETWEEN annotation.id AND annotation.last WHERE p.kind='arg' AND p.field IN ('posonlyargs','args','kwonlyargs') AND term.kind IN ('Name','Attribute') AND substr(term.name,-17)='SchemaTransaction'

stages.name: plan_aliases
stages.query: SELECT DISTINCT f.__path,f.id fn,target.name FROM functions f JOIN a assignment ON assignment.__path=f.__path AND assignment.id BETWEEN f.id AND f.last AND assignment.kind IN ('Assign','AnnAssign') JOIN a value ON value.__path=assignment.__path AND value.parent=assignment.id AND value.field='value' AND value.kind='Attribute' AND value.name='_schema_operation_plan' JOIN expression_roots root ON root.__path=value.__path AND root.id=value.id JOIN schema_parameters param ON param.__path=f.__path AND param.fn=f.id AND param.name=root.name JOIN a target ON target.__path=assignment.__path AND target.parent=assignment.id AND target.field IN ('target','targets') AND target.kind='Name'

stages.name: executing_functions
stages.query: SELECT DISTINCT f.__path,f.id FROM functions f JOIN calls call ON call.__path=f.__path AND call.id BETWEEN f.id AND f.last WHERE call.callee IN ('execute','execute_async','execute_server_plan_async','execute_server_plan_now','resolve','resolve_async','resolve_terminal_async','resolve_terminal_sync')

stages.name: lifecycle_calls
stages.query: SELECT call.*,f.id AS function_id,f.bfs function_order,f.name function_name,root.name root_name FROM functions f JOIN calls call ON call.__path=f.__path AND call.id BETWEEN f.id AND f.last LEFT JOIN expression_roots root ON root.__path=call.__path AND root.id=call.receiver
